overview: The City Council resolved multiple local matters, ordaining a vacant building ordinance after collaborating with business owners, and approving resolutions in support of local Tufts workers. The Council also voted on municipal funding requests, including a reduced supplemental appropriation for the Law Department while tabling a police chief search fund.

items.title: Westwater Remembrance
items.summary: Approved a resolution expressing condolences for the passing of John Westwater and calling on the MBTA and Amtrak to make urgent safety upgrades to the West Medford train station.

items.title: Records and Committee Reports
items.summary: Approved records from prior meetings and committee reports concerning the public tree ordinance and Fourth Amendment guidelines regarding ICE enforcement.

items.title: Noise Ordinance Update
items.summary: Referred a resolution to modernize and update the city's noise ordinance language and penalties to the Resident Services and Public Engagement Committee.

items.title: Election and Polling Relocation
items.summary: Approved the temporary relocation of the Ward 4, Precinct 2 polling place to Tufts Gancher Center and issued the call and warrant for the September 1, 2026 state primary election.

items.title: Neighborhood Ward Meetings
items.summary: Referred a resolution to schedule a series of hybrid neighborhood ward meetings hosted by the City Council back to committee.

items.title: Tufts Graduate Worker Resolution
items.summary: Approved a resolution calling on Tufts University to immediately re-enroll an international graduate student facing alleged retaliation and visa expiration after reporting contract violations.

items.title: Tufts Facilities Workers Resolution
items.summary: Approved a resolution supporting the contract demands of Tufts facilities workers who are bargaining for fair wages and healthcare premium reductions.

items.title: Police Chief Search Appropriation
items.summary: Tabled a request for $35,000 from the General Stabilization Fund to hire an executive search company for a new police chief until state legislative approval is finalized.

items.title: Board and Commission Appointments
items.summary: Approved appointments to the Zoning Board of Appeals, the Water and Sewer Commission, and the Medford Arts Council.

items.title: Community Preservation Committee Appropriations
items.summary: Approved Community Preservation Act appropriations of $32,000 for a baseball scoreboard contingency at Playstead Park and $10,000 for restorations at the Osgood House.

items.title: Unpaid Bills
items.summary: Approved a $1,500 building department expenditure to pay a fiscal year 2025 permitting platform bill.

items.title: Law Department Supplemental Appropriation
items.summary: Approved a resolution demanding detailed legal spending reports from the administration and approved a reduced Law Department supplemental appropriation of $42,507.63.

items.title: Vacant Building Ordinance
items.summary: Ordained the vacant building ordinance on third reading with several amendments, including an extension of the vacancy threshold to six months and a reduced initial registration fee.

items.title: Personnel Ordinance Amendments
items.summary: Ordained amendments to the personnel ordinance regarding Health and Human Services director positions on third reading.

items.title: Medford Commission for Persons with Disabilities
items.summary: Ordained an update to the ordinance establishing the Medford Commission for Persons with Disabilities on third reading.

items.title: Public Participation
items.summary: Members of the public spoke regarding recent ICE sightings at the courthouse and local support efforts.
